from urllib.parse import urlsplit
site=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve();endpoint=urlsplit(sys.argv[3])
sys.path[:0]=[str(site),str(root/'tests/integration'),str(root/'scripts'),str(root/'tests/unit'),str(root/'.loop/repairs/metadata-payload-erasure')]
import botocore.httpsession
send=botocore.httpsession.URLLib3Session.send
calls=[]
def local_only(self,request):
    target=urlsplit(request.url)
    assert (target.scheme,target.hostname,target.port)==(endpoint.scheme,endpoint.hostname,endpoint.port),'external SDK send prohibited'
    calls.append(True)
    return send(self,request)
botocore.httpsession.URLLib3Session.send=local_only
import pytest
code=pytest.main(['-c',str(root/'pyproject.toml'),'--rootdir',str(root.parent),'-q','-o','pythonpath=','-p','pytest_evidence',
    str(root/'tests/unit/test_dataset_group_lineage.py'),
    str(root/'tests/unit/test_dataset_lineage.py'),
    str(root/'tests/unit/test_label_lineage.py'),
    str(root/'tests/unit/test_improvement_lineage.py'),
    str(root/'tests/unit/test_resource_lineage_reader.py'),
    str(root/'tests/integration/test_dataset_group_lineage_store.py'),
    str(root/'../before/original-group-creation-oracle.py'),
    str(root/'../before/original-group-actor-oracles.py')+'::test_declassification_actor_requires_one_canonical_user_reference',
    str(root/'../before/original-group-request-oracle.py')+'::test_unmaterialized_label_request_retains_its_group_link_and_unresolved_intents',
    '--junitxml='+str(root/'evidence/local/metadata-group-installed-v1.xml')])
modules=[]
for name,module in tuple(sys.modules.items()):
    if name=='proofpack' or name.startswith('proofpack.'):
        filename=getattr(module,'__file__',None)
        if filename:
            path=pathlib.Path(filename).resolve();assert path.is_relative_to(site),(name,str(path))
            modules.append({'name':name,'path':path.relative_to(site).as_posix()})
assert calls,'owned local database must actually be used'
import cv2
assert cv2.__version__.split('.')[0]=='5','OpenCV 5 required for the synthetic media fixture'
(root/'evidence/local/metadata-group-installed-v1-child.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit_code':code,
    'installed_modules':modules,'local_sdk_sends':len(calls),'external_sdk_sends':'PROHIBITED','opencv_version':cv2.__version__,
    'oracle':'provided shared-group/raw dataset history, actual declassification/consumer/request paths and literal original oracles; includes overlaps'},indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
raise SystemExit(code)
